798	// malformedNewDocumentPath reports whether p targets one of the new
799	// long-poll/replay/merge/restore/compaction endpoints but is not that
800	// endpoint's exact location: a missing/empty segment, a trailing slash, extra
801	// segments, or a "poll"/"replay"/"merge"/"restore"/"compact" segment in a
802	// position short of the registered shape. ServeMux would answer those with a
803	// 301 redirect or a plain-text 404/405; the new endpoints promise a JSON error
804	// and never a redirect, so every such path is a malformed 400.
805	//
806	// Keywords are matched only past the documentID position, so documents that
807	// happen to be named "poll", "replay", "merge", "restore" or "compact" keep
808	// their ordinary merge/snapshot/changes routes.
809	func malformedNewDocumentPath(p string) bool {
810		rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(p, "/v1/documents/")
811		if !ok {
812			return false
813		}
814		segs := strings.Split(rest, "/")
815	
816		// The named-snapshot-version subtree ({documentID}/snapshots/versions/...)
817		// owns its whole shape verdict through malformedSnapshotPath. A version
818		// name may coincide with a change keyword ("poll", "merge", "restore",
819		// "subscribe", "compact"), so none of the keyword loops below may judge a
820		// path inside that subtree; leave it to the snapshot guard.
821		if len(segs) >= 3 && segs[0] != "" && segs[1] == "snapshots" && segs[2] == "versions" {
822			return false
823		}
824	
825		// Poll endpoint: "poll" must be exactly the third segment, after a
826		// non-empty documentID and "changes".
827		for i, seg := range segs {
828			if seg == "poll" && i > 0 {
829				return !(len(segs) == 3 && segs[0] != "" && segs[1] == "changes")
830			}
831		}
832		// Document change subscription: "subscribe" must be exactly the third
833		// segment, after a non-empty documentID and "changes". The CRDT namespace
834		// has its own state/subscribe endpoint and its own guard, so a "subscribe"
835		// under crdt/ is not the change-subscription keyword.
836		for i, seg := range segs {
837			if seg == "subscribe" && i > 0 {
838				if len(segs) >= 2 && segs[1] == "crdt" {
839					continue
840				}
841				return !(len(segs) == 3 && segs[0] != "" && segs[1] == "changes")
842			}
843		}
844		// Replay endpoint: "replay" must be exactly the second segment, after a
845		// non-empty documentID.
846		for i, seg := range segs {
847			if seg == "replay" && i > 0 {
848				return !(len(segs) == 2 && segs[0] != "")
849			}
850		}
851		// Merge and restore endpoints: each keyword must be exactly the second
852		// segment, after a non-empty documentID (they are document-item
853		// subresources, unlike poll/compact which sit below the change
854		// collection). A keyword used as a version name inside the versions
855		// subtree was excluded by the early return above.
856		for _, keyword := range []string{"merge", "restore"} {
857			for i, seg := range segs {
858				if seg == keyword && i > 0 {
859					return !(len(segs) == 2 && segs[0] != "")
860				}
861			}
862		}
863		// Compaction endpoint: "compact" must be exactly the third segment, after
864		// a non-empty documentID and "changes". The CRDT namespace has its own
865		// guard; "compact" there is the CRDT compaction keyword, not the
866		// change-log one.
867		for i, seg := range segs {
868			if seg == "compact" && i > 0 {
869				if len(segs) >= 2 && segs[1] == "crdt" {
870					return false
871				}
872				return !(len(segs) == 3 && segs[0] != "" && segs[1] == "changes")
873			}
874		}
875		return false
876	}

878	// malformedSubscribePath reports whether p targets the WebSocket subscription
879	// endpoint but is not at its exact location
880	// (/v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/changes/subscribe): a
881	// missing "documents"/"changes" segment, an extra segment, or a "subscribe"
882	// segment short of the registered shape. ServeMux would answer those with a
883	// plain-text 404/405; every failure of this endpoint must be a JSON 400
884	// instead. Empty segments are already rejected by the guard itself.
885	//
886	// "subscribe" is treated as the endpoint keyword only in the endpoint's
887	// terminal segment position (the fifth segment, index 4); a session or
888	// document identifier literally named "subscribe" occupies an identifier
889	// position (index 0 or 2) and is therefore left to the ordinary
890	// changes/subscribe routes like any other id.
891	func malformedSubscribePath(p string) bool {
892		rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(p, "/v1/sessions/")
893		if !ok {
894			return false
895		}
896		segs := strings.Split(rest, "/")
897		// The CRDT namespace ("crdt" immediately past the document identifier)
898		// has its own guard; "subscribe" there is not the changes-subscribe
899		// keyword.
900		if len(segs) >= 4 && segs[1] == "documents" && segs[3] == "crdt" {
901			return false
902		}
903		// The named-snapshot-version subtree owns its whole shape verdict; a
904		// version name coinciding with "subscribe" is an ordinary identifier
905		// there, not the change-subscription keyword.
906		if inSessionSnapshotVersionsSubtree(segs) {
907			return false
908		}
909		for i, seg := range segs {
910			if seg != "subscribe" {
911				continue
912			}
913			// Identifier positions: sessionId (0) and documentId (2). A value of
914			// "subscribe" there is an ordinary identifier, not the endpoint word.
915			if i == 0 || i == 2 {
916				continue
917			}
918			// Endpoint keyword position: the fifth segment must be exactly
919			// "subscribe" with the documents/changes scaffolding around it, and no
920			// segment may follow. Any other occurrence is a malformed path.
921			if i == 4 && len(segs) == 5 &&
922				segs[0] != "" &&
923				segs[1] == "documents" &&
924				segs[2] != "" &&
925				segs[3] == "changes" {
926				return false
927			}
928			return true
929		}
930		return false
931	}

933	// malformedSessionCRDTPath reports whether p targets the session-scoped CRDT
934	// namespace but is not at one of its six exact locations:
935	//
936	//	POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/ops
937	//	GET  /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/state
938	//	POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/compact
939	//	POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/query
940	//	GET  /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/list
941	//	GET  /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/state/subscribe
942	//
943	// a missing "ops"/"state"/"compact"/"query"/"list"/"subscribe" segment, an extra
944	// segment, or a "crdt" segment in the keyword position (immediately past the
945	// document identifier) short of one of the registered shapes. ServeMux would
946	// answer those with a plain-text 404/405; every failure of these endpoints
947	// must be a JSON 400 instead. Empty segments are already rejected by the
948	// guard itself.
949	//
950	// "crdt" is treated as the endpoint keyword only in the fourth segment (index
951	// 3, right after the document identifier); a session or document identifier
952	// literally named "crdt" occupies an identifier position (index 0 or 2) and
953	// keeps its ordinary routes. Likewise "compact", "query" and "list" are
954	// endpoint keywords only in the fifth segment; a session or document literally
955	// named any of them is an ordinary identifier.
956	func malformedSessionCRDTPath(p string) bool {
957		rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(p, "/v1/sessions/")
958		if !ok {
959			return false
960		}
961		segs := strings.Split(rest, "/")
962		if len(segs) < 4 || segs[1] != "documents" || segs[3] != "crdt" {
963			return false
964		}
965		// Keyword position reached. The batch commit, the state read, the
966		// compaction, the batch lookup and the ordered listing are all exactly
967		// {sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/{ops,state,compact,query,list};
968		// the subscription adds one trailing "subscribe" segment.
969		validOps := len(segs) == 5 &&
970			segs[0] != "" &&
971			segs[2] != "" &&
972			segs[4] == "ops"
973		validState := len(segs) == 5 &&
974			segs[0] != "" &&
975			segs[2] != "" &&
976			segs[4] == "state"
977		validCompact := len(segs) == 5 &&
978			segs[0] != "" &&
979			segs[2] != "" &&
980			segs[4] == "compact"
981		validQuery := len(segs) == 5 &&
982			segs[0] != "" &&
983			segs[2] != "" &&
984			segs[4] == "query"
985		validList := len(segs) == 5 &&
986			segs[0] != "" &&
987			segs[2] != "" &&
988			segs[4] == "list"
989		validSubscribe := len(segs) == 6 &&
990			segs[0] != "" &&
991			segs[2] != "" &&
992			segs[4] == "state" &&
993			segs[5] == "subscribe"
994		return !(validOps || validState || validCompact || validQuery || validList || validSubscribe)
995	}

1007	// decodeJSONBody enforces the strict POST contract shared by every JSON
1008	// endpoint: Content-Type must be application/json, the body is capped at
1009	// maxBatchBytes, it must contain exactly one JSON value, and no trailing data
1010	// may follow it. Any violation writes a 400 JSON error and returns false; the
1011	// caller returns immediately, so no handler reaches the store with malformed
1012	// input and rejected requests write nothing.
1013	func decodeJSONBody(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, dst any) bool {
1014		mediaType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
1015		if err != nil || mediaType != "application/json" {
1016			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Content-Type must be application/json")
1017			return false
1018		}
1019	
1020		r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, maxBatchBytes)
1021		dec := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
1022		if err := dec.Decode(dst); err != nil {
1023			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid JSON body: "+err.Error())
1024			return false
1025		}
1026		// Reject trailing data after the JSON value.
1027		if err := dec.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
1028			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid JSON body: unexpected trailing content")
1029			return false
1030		}
1031		return true
1032	}

175			}

1	// Package app is the composition root: it opens the one shared database and
2	// constructs the three independently reusable internal services — the change
3	// event service, the permission service and the CRDT state service — wiring
4	// them together only through their internal interfaces.
5	//
6	// The services share one SQLite connection (the kernel opens a single
7	// pooled connection with immediate transactions), so a change commit, a CRDT
8	// submission or compaction, and a permission change are serialized on the
9	// same connection and leave no half-written batch. The change event and CRDT
10	// services take their registration-and-authorization verdict from the
11	// permission service inside their own transactions (events.Gate / crdt.Gate),
12	// and the permission service fans a committed revoke out to their
13	// subscription registries through authz.RevokeSink. No service reaches into
14	// another service's tables or fields.
15	//
16	// App is the single object the entry and HTTP layers use. It promotes each
17	// service's input/output boundary as its methods while hiding the wiring; it
18	// adds no authentication and exposes no endpoint of its own.
19	package app
20	
21	import (
22		"context"
23		"encoding/json"
24		"time"
25	
26		"github.com/alicegogogogogo/local-first-sync-service/internal/authz"
27		"github.com/alicegogogogogo/local-first-sync-service/internal/crdt"
28		"github.com/alicegogogogogo/local-first-sync-service/internal/events"
29		"github.com/alicegogogogogo/local-first-sync-service/internal/push"
30		"github.com/alicegogogogogo/local-first-sync-service/internal/store"
31	)
32	
33	// App composes the durable kernel and the three internal services over one
34	// shared database connection.
35	type App struct {
36		*store.Store
37	
38		events *events.Service
39		crdt   *crdt.Service
40	
41		// pushSubs is the process-wide, in-memory registry of the live push
42		// connections across both channels. It backs the device-scoped
43		// subscription management endpoints and holds no durable state.
44		pushSubs *push.Registry
45	
46		// Authz is the permission service. It is exposed so the HTTP layer can
47		// grant/revoke and read authorization directly; the other services reach
48		// it through their gates rather than this field.
49		Authz *authz.Service
50	}
51	
52	// Open opens (creating if needed) the SQLite database at path and constructs
53	// every internal service over it. The empty path opens a private in-memory
54	// database useful for tests. A construction failure closes the kernel and
55	// leaves nothing behind.
56	func Open(path string) (*App, error) {
57		kernel, err := store.Open(path)
58		if err != nil {
59			return nil, err
60		}
61	
62		// The permission service is built first: its gate is a constructor
63		// dependency of the change event and CRDT services.
64		permissions, err := authz.New(kernel)
65		if err != nil {
66			_ = kernel.Close()
67			return nil, err
68		}
69		eventService, err := events.New(kernel, permissions)
70		if err != nil {
71			_ = kernel.Close()
72			return nil, err
73		}
74		crdtService, err := crdt.New(kernel, permissions)
75		if err != nil {
76			_ = kernel.Close()
77			return nil, err
78		}
79	
80		// A committed revoke ends the affected live subscriptions in both
81		// push channels. The dependency is an interface, registered once here, so
82		// the permission service never names either subscriber concretely.
83		permissions.AddRevokeSink(eventsRevokeSink{eventService})
84		permissions.AddRevokeSink(crdtService)
85	
86		return &App{
87			Store:    kernel,
88			events:   eventService,
89			crdt:     crdtService,
90			Authz:    permissions,
91			pushSubs: push.NewRegistry(),
92		}, nil
93	}
94	
95	// eventsRevokeSink adapts the change event service's revoke hook to the
96	// permission service's RevokeSink interface.
97	type eventsRevokeSink struct{ e *events.Service }
98	
99	func (s eventsRevokeSink) PermissionRevoked(documentID, deviceID string) {
100		s.e.SignalRevoked(documentID, deviceID)
101	}
102	
103	// Events returns the change event service.
104	func (a *App) Events() *events.Service { return a.events }
105	
106	// CRDT returns the CRDT state service.
107	func (a *App) CRDT() *crdt.Service { return a.crdt }
108	
109	// ---- Change event service boundary (promoted so the entry layer has one
110	// object; each method delegates verbatim to the events service). ----
111	
112	// InterruptWaits wakes every parked long poll and every live change-log and
113	// CRDT subscription without closing the database, so an orderly shutdown
114	// drains waiting connections (long polls answer 503; subscriptions finish
115	// with the going-away close) instead of holding the drain hostage.
116	func (a *App) InterruptWaits() {
117		a.events.InterruptWaits()
118		a.crdt.InterruptWaits()
119	}
120	
121	// Closing reports whether shutdown has begun, covering both push channels.
122	func (a *App) Closing() bool {
123		return a.events.Closing() || a.crdt.Closing()
124	}
125	
126	// Close interrupts the in-memory observers, waits for every subscription
127	// handler to unregister and then releases the shared database handle.
128	func (a *App) Close() error {
129		a.events.InterruptWaits()
130		a.crdt.InterruptWaits()
131		a.events.WaitDrained()
132		a.crdt.WaitDrained()
133		return a.Store.Close()
134	}
135	
136	// PostChanges delegates to the change event service.
137	func (a *App) PostChanges(documentID string, changes []events.Change) ([]events.Result, error) {
138		return a.events.PostChanges(documentID, changes)
139	}
140	
141	// ReplayChanges delegates to the change event service.
142	func (a *App) ReplayChanges(documentID string, changes []events.Change) ([]events.Result, error) {
143		return a.events.ReplayChanges(documentID, changes)
144	}
145	
146	// PostSessionChanges commits a batch whose device identity was resolved from
147	// a session by the HTTP layer, delegating to the change event service's
148	// gated commit: the registration/permission verdict is taken inside the same
149	// serialized transaction as the write, so a revoked device commits nothing.
150	func (a *App) PostSessionChanges(documentID string, changes []events.Change) ([]events.Result, error) {
151		return a.events.CommitAuthorized(documentID, changes)
152	}
153	
154	// ReplaySessionChanges replays an offline batch whose device identity was
155	// resolved from a session by the HTTP layer; it is the session counterpart
156	// to ReplayChanges and commits through the same gated transaction the
157	// session-scoped batch commit uses, so the two paths cannot drift.
158	func (a *App) ReplaySessionChanges(documentID string, changes []events.Change) ([]events.Result, error) {
159		return a.events.CommitAuthorized(documentID, changes)
160	}
161	
162	// MergeChange delegates to the change event service.
163	func (a *App) MergeChange(documentID string, baseCursor int64, c events.Change) (events.MergeResult, error) {
164		return a.events.MergeChange(documentID, baseCursor, c)
165	}
166	
167	// MergeSessionChange merges a single change whose device identity was resolved
168	// from a session by the HTTP layer, delegating to the change event service's
169	// gated merge: the registration/permission verdict is taken inside the same
170	// serialized transaction as the merge judgment and append, so a revoked device
171	// writes nothing and a rejected request observes no change content.
172	func (a *App) MergeSessionChange(documentID string, baseCursor int64, c events.Change) (events.MergeResult, error) {
173		return a.events.MergeChangeAuthorized(documentID, baseCursor, c)
174	}
175	
176	// PutSnapshot delegates to the change event service.
177	func (a *App) PutSnapshot(documentID string, cursor int64, state json.RawMessage) (bool, error) {
178		return a.events.PutSnapshot(documentID, cursor, state)
179	}
180	
181	// GetSnapshot delegates to the change event service.
182	func (a *App) GetSnapshot(documentID string, cursor int64) (json.RawMessage, error) {
183		return a.events.GetSnapshot(documentID, cursor)
184	}
185	
186	// ExportSnapshots delegates to the change event service. A nil to means the
187	// interval has no upper bound.
188	func (a *App) ExportSnapshots(documentID string, from int64, to *int64) ([]events.ExportedSnapshot, error) {
189		return a.events.ExportSnapshots(documentID, from, to)
190	}
191	
192	// RestoreSnapshot delegates to the change event service.
193	func (a *App) RestoreSnapshot(documentID, deviceID, changeID string, snapshotCursor int64) (events.RestoreResult, error) {
194		return a.events.RestoreSnapshot(documentID, deviceID, changeID, snapshotCursor)
195	}
196	
197	// RestoreSessionSnapshot restores a snapshot as an ordinary change whose
198	// device identity was resolved from a session by the HTTP layer, delegating to
199	// the change event service's gated restore: the registration/permission

309	// DeregisterDevice removes a registered device together with every record it
310	// owns — its sessions, the attachments it created (chunks, sealed state and
311	// unfinished uploads included), the access grants it held, and its
312	// document-permission rows — all in one serialized transaction that commits
313	// synchronously. An unknown or already deregistered device yields
314	// store.ErrDeviceNotFound and writes nothing, so a repeat deregistration
315	// misses exactly the way a never-registered id does and concurrent calls take
316	// effect at most once. Shared digest-addressed content is reclaimed only when
317	// the last completed attachment referencing it is gone; other devices'
318	// changes, snapshots and document content are untouched.
319	//
320	// After the commit the same id may register again as a brand-new device — no
321	// session, permission or attachment is inherited — and every live
322	// subscription the device held across both push channels is ended
323	// immediately, stickily.
324	func (a *App) DeregisterDevice(deviceID string) error {
325		tx, err := a.Store.DB().Begin()
326		if err != nil {
327			return err
328		}
329		defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
330	
331		if err := store.DeleteDeviceTx(tx, deviceID); err != nil {
332			return err
333		}
334		if err := a.Authz.DeleteDevicePermissionsTx(tx, deviceID); err != nil {
335			return err
336		}
337		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
338			return err
339		}
340	
341		// End the device's live subscriptions only after the cascade is durable:
342		// a reconnect attempt after the close finds the backing session gone
343		// (404), so the connection cannot immediately re-establish itself.
344		a.events.SignalDeviceDeregistered(deviceID)
345		a.crdt.SignalDeviceDeregistered(deviceID)
346		return nil
347	}

349	// ---- Document-level deletion. ----
350	
351	// DeleteDocument removes a registered device's whole document in one
352	// serialized, synchronously committed transaction. The calling device is
353	// declared by deviceId — no new authentication is introduced.
354	//
355	// The fixed verdict order is taken inside the transaction, before any cleanup:
356	//
357	//   - an unregistered device yields store.ErrDeviceNotFound (404) and writes
358	//     nothing;
359	//   - a device whose permission for the document was revoked yields
360	//     store.ErrPermissionDenied (403) and no cleanup runs;
361	//   - a document with no durable data anywhere — never created or already
362	//     deleted — yields events.ErrDocumentNotFound (404) and writes nothing.
363	//
364	// On success every row of the document is removed as one judgment: its online
365	// and trimmed change log, the retained idempotency summaries, its snapshots
366	// and named snapshot-version markers, its CRDT state and the per-document
367	// permission ledger. The same id is a brand-new document afterward — the
368	// cursor space restarts at 1 — and inherits no history or version names.
369	// Concurrent deletes commit at most once because the existence verdict and
370	// the deletions share one immediate transaction on the single connection.
371	//
372	// Only after the commit is durable are the document's live subscriptions
373	// ended (close code 4420 on both push channels) and dropped from the
374	// management registry; other documents' and devices' connections are
375	// untouched.
376	func (a *App) DeleteDocument(documentID, deviceID string) error {
377		tx, err := a.Store.DB().Begin()
378		if err != nil {
379			return err
380		}
381		defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
382	
383		// Registration first, then permission, both before any document content
384		// is observed: a rejected delete reveals nothing and cleans nothing.
385		if err := a.Authz.AuthorizedTx(tx, documentID, deviceID); err != nil {
386			return err
387		}
388	
389		eventsExist, err := a.events.DocumentDataExistsTx(tx, documentID)
390		if err != nil {
391			return err
392		}
393		crdtExist, err := a.crdt.DocumentDataExistsTx(tx, documentID)
394		if err != nil {
395			return err
396		}
397		// A ledger-only deviation row also counts as document data, so a document
398		// whose only durable trace is a grant/revoke still deletes cleanly and the
399		// re-created id inherits no authorization state.
400		ledgerExist, err := a.Authz.DocumentHasRowsTx(tx, documentID)
401		if err != nil {
402			return err
403		}
404		if !eventsExist && !crdtExist && !ledgerExist {
405			return events.ErrDocumentNotFound
406		}
407	
408		if err := a.events.DeleteDocumentDataTx(tx, documentID); err != nil {
409			return err
410		}
411		if err := a.crdt.DeleteDocumentDataTx(tx, documentID); err != nil {
412			return err
413		}
414		if err := a.Authz.DeleteDocumentPermissionsTx(tx, documentID); err != nil {
415			return err
416		}
417	
418		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
419			return err
420		}
421	
422		// End the document's live subscriptions on both channels and drop them
423		// from the management registry only after the cleanup is durable: the
424		// close is one-shot per connection, so a client re-subscribing to the
425		// now-fresh id opens a new connection and never reopens the ended ones.
426		a.events.SignalDocumentDeleted(documentID)
427		a.crdt.SignalDocumentDeleted(documentID)
428		a.CloseDocumentPush(documentID)
429		return nil
430	}

1	// Change-log compaction moves the old end of a document's change log out of
2	// the online tables without touching the cursor space the log shares with
3	// every write path.
4	//
5	// The compaction boundary is the greatest cursor that has a saved snapshot
6	// (zero when the document has none): everything at or below it is reproducible
7	// from a snapshot plus the surviving tail, so those rows leave the online log.
8	// A trimmed change is not forgotten, though — its id keeps a small canonical
9	// summary (the originating device, a digest of the payload and, for a restore,
10	// the snapshot it came from, plus the cursor it was first assigned) so the
11	// submission layer keeps answering idempotency and conflict exactly as before.
12	// The summary never participates in reads: pagination, long polling and
13	// subscriptions simply no longer see the trimmed rows, and the summary's
14	// fixed size means storage does not grow back to the pre-compaction shape.
15	//
16	// Compaction itself is not a change: it allocates no cursor, writes no change
17	// record and wakes no waiter or subscriber. The cursor space never resets —
18	// the next allocated cursor is one past the greater of the online maximum and
19	// the boundary — and the boundary, the summaries and the read results are
20	// durable across restarts.
21	
22	package events
23	
24	import (
25		"bytes"
26		"crypto/sha256"
27		"database/sql"
28		"encoding/json"
29		"errors"
30	
31		"github.com/alicegogogogogo/local-first-sync-service/internal/store"
32	)
33	
34	// CompactChanges moves every change of documentID whose cursor is at or below
35	// the compaction boundary out of the online log, in one serialized
36	// transaction, and returns the boundary together with the number of changes
37	// removed by this call.
38	//
39	// The boundary is the greatest cursor with a saved snapshot, or zero when the
40	// document has no snapshot — compacting a snapshot-less or unknown document
41	// succeeds and removes nothing. The gate is enforced before any content is
42	// observed, exactly as in ReplayChanges: an unregistered device yields
43	// store.ErrDeviceNotFound and a revoked device yields store.ErrPermissionDenied,
44	// and neither touches any state.
45	//
46	// Each trimmed id keeps its canonical summary (device, payload digest, restore
47	// provenance and first cursor) so re-posting it stays idempotent and a
48	// differing re-post stays a conflict. Compaction is idempotent: a repeat finds
49	// the same boundary, trims nothing and reports zero removed. It commits no
50	// change row, allocates no cursor and notifies no waiter or subscriber.
51	func (s *Service) CompactChanges(documentID, deviceID string) (boundary, removed int64, err error) {
52		tx, err := s.db.Begin()
53		if err != nil {
54			return 0, 0, err
55		}
56		defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
57	
58		// Registration and permission are enforced before any change content is
59		// observed, so a rejected compaction cannot reveal anything.
60		if s.gate != nil {
61			if err := s.gate.DeviceAuthorizedTx(tx, documentID, deviceID); err != nil {
62				return 0, 0, err
63			}
64		}
65	
66		// The boundary is the greatest cursor with a saved snapshot, 0 when the
67		// document has none (an unknown document included).
68		if err := tx.QueryRow(
69			`SELECT COALESCE(MAX(cursor), 0) FROM snapshots WHERE document_id = ?`,
70			documentID,
71		).Scan(&boundary); err != nil {
72			return 0, 0, err
73		}
74		stored, err := boundaryOfTx(tx, documentID)
75		if err != nil {
76			return 0, 0, err
77		}
78		if boundary <= stored {
79			// Nothing new to trim (a repeat compaction, or a snapshot-less
80			// document): report the standing boundary and remove nothing.
81			return stored, 0, tx.Commit()
82		}
83	
84		// Collect the rows leaving the online log before deleting them: each one
85		// first moves its canonical summary into the identity table.
86		type trimmed struct {
87			cursor  int64
88			id      string
89			device  string
90			payload []byte
91		}
92		rows, err := tx.Query(
93			`SELECT cursor, id, device_id, payload FROM changes
94			 WHERE document_id = ? AND cursor <= ?
95			 ORDER BY cursor ASC`,
96			documentID, boundary,
97		)
98		if err != nil {
99			return 0, 0, err
100		}
101		var dropping []trimmed
102		for rows.Next() {
103			var t trimmed
104			if err := rows.Scan(&t.cursor, &t.id, &t.device, &t.payload); err != nil {
105				_ = rows.Close()
106				return 0, 0, err
107			}
108			dropping = append(dropping, t)
109		}
110		if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
111			_ = rows.Close()
112			return 0, 0, err
113		}
114		_ = rows.Close()
115	
116		for _, t := range dropping {
117			// A restored change also carries its provenance into the summary, so a
118			// repeated restore keeps its idempotency/conflict decision.
119			var restoredFrom sql.NullInt64
120			err := tx.QueryRow(
121				`SELECT snapshot_cursor FROM restores WHERE document_id = ? AND change_id = ?`,
122				documentID, t.id,
123			).Scan(&restoredFrom)
124			switch {
125			case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
126				restoredFrom = sql.NullInt64{}
127			case err != nil:
128				return 0, 0, err
129			}
130			digest, err := payloadDigest(t.payload)
131			if err != nil {
132				return 0, 0, err
133			}
134			if _, err := tx.Exec(
135				`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO change_identities
136					(document_id, id, device_id, digest, cursor, restored_from)
137				 VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
138				documentID, t.id, t.device, digest, t.cursor, restoredFrom,
139			); err != nil {
140				return 0, 0, err
141			}
142		}
143	
144		if _, err := tx.Exec(
145			`DELETE FROM restores WHERE document_id = ? AND change_cursor <= ?`,
146			documentID, boundary,
147		); err != nil {
148			return 0, 0, err
149		}
150		if _, err := tx.Exec(
151			`DELETE FROM changes WHERE document_id = ? AND cursor <= ?`,
152			documentID, boundary,
153		); err != nil {
154			return 0, 0, err
155		}
156		if _, err := tx.Exec(
157			`INSERT INTO change_boundaries (document_id, boundary) VALUES (?, ?)
158			 ON CONFLICT (document_id) DO UPDATE SET boundary = excluded.boundary`,
159			documentID, boundary,
160		); err != nil {
161			return 0, 0, err
162		}
163	
164		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
165			return 0, 0, err
166		}
167		// Compaction is not a change: no waiter is woken and no subscriber is
168		// signaled, because no new change exists to observe.
169		return boundary, int64(len(dropping)), nil
170	}
171	
172	// boundaryOfTx returns the stored compaction boundary of documentID, or zero
173	// when the document was never compacted.
174	func boundaryOfTx(q store.DBTX, documentID string) (int64, error) {
175		var boundary int64
176		err := q.QueryRow(
177			`SELECT boundary FROM change_boundaries WHERE document_id = ?`,
178			documentID,
179		).Scan(&boundary)
180		switch {
181		case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
182			return 0, nil
183		case err != nil:
184			return 0, err
185		default:
186			return boundary, nil
187		}
188	}
189	
190	// currentCursorTx returns the document's high-water mark: the greatest online
191	// cursor, or the compaction boundary when every change up to it has left the
192	// online log. The cursor space never resets, so a fully trimmed document
193	// continues from its boundary rather than from zero.
194	func currentCursorTx(tx *sql.Tx, documentID string) (int64, error) {
195		var maxOnline int64
196		if err := tx.QueryRow(
197			`SELECT COALESCE(MAX(cursor), 0) FROM changes WHERE document_id = ?`,
198			documentID,
199		).Scan(&maxOnline); err != nil {
200			return 0, err
201		}
202		boundary, err := boundaryOfTx(tx, documentID)
203		if err != nil {
204			return 0, err
205		}
206		if boundary > maxOnline {
207			maxOnline = boundary
208		}
209		return maxOnline, nil
210	}
211	
212	// payloadDigest renders a payload in the canonical form JSONEqual compares —
213	// the decoded value re-encoded, so 1 and 1.0 or reordered object keys digest
214	// alike — and hashes it. The digest is the fixed-size stand-in for the payload
215	// in a trimmed change's retained summary.
216	func payloadDigest(payload json.RawMessage) ([]byte, error) {
217		var v any
218		if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &v); err != nil {
219			return nil, err
220		}
221		canonical, err := json.Marshal(v)
222		if err != nil {
223			return nil, err
224		}
225		sum := sha256.Sum256(canonical)
226		return sum[:], nil
227	}

229	// resolveTrimmedIdentity answers the submission question for an id whose
230	// online row is absent because compaction trimmed it. It returns found=true
231	// and the id's first cursor when the retained summary matches the incoming
232	// device and payload (an idempotent re-post), an *ErrConflict when a retained
233	// summary exists but differs, and found=false when no summary was retained (a
234	// genuinely new id).
235	func resolveTrimmedIdentity(tx *sql.Tx, documentID string, c Change) (found bool, cursor int64, err error) {
236		var device string
237		var digest []byte
238		err = tx.QueryRow(
239			`SELECT device_id, digest, cursor FROM change_identities WHERE document_id = ? AND id = ?`,
240			documentID, c.ID,
241		).Scan(&device, &digest, &cursor)
242		switch {
243		case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
244			return false, 0, nil
245		case err != nil:
246			return false, 0, err
247		}
248	
249		incoming, err := payloadDigest(c.Payload)
250		if err != nil {
251			return false, 0, err
252		}
253		if device != c.DeviceID || !bytes.Equal(digest, incoming) {
254			return false, 0, &ErrConflict{ID: c.ID}
255		}
256		return true, cursor, nil
257	}

1	package events
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"database/sql"
6		"time"
7	)
8	
9	// DocumentExists reports whether documentID is a known document rather than an
10	// empty namespace: it has any online change row, or a compaction boundary from
11	// a log that was (fully or partially) trimmed.
12	func (s *Service) DocumentExists(documentID string) (bool, error) {
13		var known bool
14		if err := s.db.QueryRow(
15			`SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM changes WHERE document_id = ?)
16			 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM change_boundaries WHERE document_id = ?)`,
17			documentID, documentID,
18		).Scan(&known); err != nil {
19			return false, err
20		}
21		return known, nil
22	}
23	
24	// ListChanges returns at most limit changes for documentID whose cursor is
25	// greater than after and still online, in cursor order, together with the
26	// cursor to pass as the next after value. An unknown document yields an empty
27	// list and cursor 0; a known document with no rows past after yields
28	// nextCursor == max(after, boundary), so a caller positioned inside the
29	// trimmed range resumes from the compaction boundary.
30	func (s *Service) ListChanges(documentID string, after, limit int64) ([]ListedChange, int64, error) {
31		rows, err := s.db.Query(
32			`SELECT id, device_id, payload, cursor FROM changes
33			 WHERE document_id = ? AND cursor > ?
34			 ORDER BY cursor ASC
35			 LIMIT ?`,
36			documentID, after, limit,
37		)
38		if err != nil {
39			return nil, 0, err
40		}
41		defer func() { _ = rows.Close() }()
42	
43		out := make([]ListedChange, 0)
44		var maxCursor int64 = after
45		for rows.Next() {
46			var c ListedChange
47			if err := rows.Scan(&c.ID, &c.DeviceID, &c.Payload, &c.Cursor); err != nil {
48				return nil, 0, err
49			}
50			out = append(out, c)
51			maxCursor = c.Cursor
52		}
53		if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
54			return nil, 0, err
55		}
56	
57		// Distinguish an unknown document from a known one with nothing new:
58		// unknown documents must report nextCursor 0, while a known document
59		// reports the greater of after and the compaction boundary.
60		if len(out) == 0 {
61			known, err := s.DocumentExists(documentID)
62			if err != nil {
63				return nil, 0, err
64			}
65			if !known {
66				return out, 0, nil
67			}
68			boundary, err := boundaryOfTx(s.db, documentID)
69			if err != nil {
70				return nil, 0, err
71			}
72			if boundary > maxCursor {
73				maxCursor = boundary
74			}
75		}
76		return out, maxCursor, nil
77	}
78	
79	// ExportChanges returns every change of documentID whose cursor lies in the
80	// closed interval [from, to] and is still in the online log, in ascending
81	// cursor order. When to is nil no upper bound is applied. An unknown document,
82	// or a range without any online change — including one that lies entirely
83	// inside the trimmed region — yields an empty list and no error: the export is
84	// a read that misses like any other. The (document_id, cursor) unique index
85	// guarantees a cursor appears at most once.
86	//
87	// The single SELECT runs as one SQLite statement over the serialized
88	// connection, so a batch committed concurrently is observed either with all of
89	// its rows or not at all — never half of it. The read starts no transaction,
90	// writes nothing and notifies no waiters, so it cannot move a cursor, produce
91	// a change record or wake a parked poll. Each returned row is the same record
92	// the paged read emits at that cursor.
93	func (s *Service) ExportChanges(documentID string, from int64, to *int64) ([]ListedChange, error) {
94		var (
95			rows *sql.Rows
96			err  error
97		)
98		if to == nil {
99			rows, err = s.db.Query(
100				`SELECT id, device_id, payload, cursor FROM changes
101				 WHERE document_id = ? AND cursor >= ?
102				 ORDER BY cursor ASC`,
103				documentID, from,
104			)
105		} else {
106			rows, err = s.db.Query(
107				`SELECT id, device_id, payload, cursor FROM changes
108				 WHERE document_id = ? AND cursor >= ? AND cursor <= ?
109				 ORDER BY cursor ASC`,
110				documentID, from, *to,
111			)
112		}
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, err
115		}
116		defer func() { _ = rows.Close() }()
117	
118		out := make([]ListedChange, 0)
119		for rows.Next() {
120			var c ListedChange
121			if err := rows.Scan(&c.ID, &c.DeviceID, &c.Payload, &c.Cursor); err != nil {
122				return nil, err
123			}
124			out = append(out, c)
125		}
126		if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
127			return nil, err
128		}
129		return out, nil
130	}
131	
132	// WaitForChanges blocks until documentID has a change with cursor greater than
133	// after, a change is committed while waiting, wait elapses, ctx is canceled
134	// (the client disconnected) or the service stops. It then returns the current
135	// page of up to limit changes exactly as ListChanges would, with timedOut=true
136	// only when the wait deadline expired with no new rows.
137	//
138	// Registration precedes the first query: a commit landing between the read and
139	// the park still notifies a registered channel, so no change is missed.
140	//
141	// An unknown document is never parked on: it returns immediately with an empty
142	// list and nextCursor 0, timedOut=false. Data already past after is likewise
143	// returned immediately. wait <= 0 is an immediately expired deadline.
144	func (s *Service) WaitForChanges(ctx context.Context, documentID string, after, limit int64, wait time.Duration) (changes []ListedChange, nextCursor int64, timedOut bool, err error) {
145		ch, remove := s.registerWait(documentID)
146		defer remove()
147	
148		changes, nextCursor, err = s.ListChanges(documentID, after, limit)
149		if err != nil || len(changes) > 0 {
150			return changes, nextCursor, false, err
151		}
152	
153		// Empty page: distinguish an unknown document (immediate empty/0, never
154		// parked on) from a known document caught up to after.
155		known, err := s.DocumentExists(documentID)
156		if err != nil || !known {
157			return changes, 0, false, err
158		}
159	
160		// Known document, nothing new: a zero wait is an immediately expired
161		// deadline; ListChanges already echoes nextCursor == after.
162		if wait <= 0 {
163			return changes, nextCursor, true, nil
164		}
165	
166		timer := time.NewTimer(wait)
167		defer timer.Stop()
168	
169		select {
170		case <-ch:
171			// Woken by a committed change, a whole-document deletion, or
172			// InterruptWaits. A deleted document is an unknown document now: answer
173			// an empty page at cursor 0 with timedOut=false rather than reporting a
174			// deadline expiry. Any other empty re-read keeps the old timeout shape.
175			s.mu.Lock()
176			closing := s.closed
177			s.mu.Unlock()
178			if closing {
179				return nil, 0, false, ErrStoreClosing
180			}
181			changes, nextCursor, err = s.ListChanges(documentID, after, limit)
182			if err != nil {
183				return nil, 0, false, err
184			}
185			if len(changes) == 0 {
186				known, knownErr := s.DocumentExists(documentID)
187				if knownErr != nil {
188					return nil, 0, false, knownErr
189				}
190				if !known {
191					return changes, 0, false, nil
192				}
193			}
194			return changes, nextCursor, len(changes) == 0, err
195		case <-timer.C:
196			// Timeout with no new rows: echo the caller's cursor without
197			// advancing it. The document was known above, so ListChanges returns
198			// nextCursor == after for an empty page.
199			changes, nextCursor, err = s.ListChanges(documentID, after, limit)
200			return changes, nextCursor, len(changes) == 0, err
201		case <-ctx.Done():
202			return nil, 0, false, ctx.Err()
203		}
204	}
205	
206	// registerWait parks a channel for documentID and returns it together with a
207	// removal function. The channel is closed on the next committed change to the
208	// document, or when the service stops.
209	func (s *Service) registerWait(documentID string) (ch chan struct{}, remove func()) {
210		ch = make(chan struct{}, 1)
211	
212		s.mu.Lock()
213		defer s.mu.Unlock()
214		if s.closed {
215			// Shutdown beat the registration: signal immediately so the caller does
216			// not park on a channel nobody will close.
217			close(ch)
218			return ch, func() {}
219		}
220		s.nextWait++
221		id := s.nextWait
222		set := s.waits[documentID]
223		if set == nil {
224			set = make(map[uint64]chan struct{})
225			s.waits[documentID] = set
226		}
227		set[id] = ch
228		return ch, func() {
229			s.mu.Lock()
230			if set, ok := s.waits[documentID]; ok {
231				delete(set, id)
232				if len(set) == 0 {
233					delete(s.waits, documentID)
234				}
235			}
236			s.mu.Unlock()
237		}
238	}
239	
240	// notifyWaiters signals every long poll parked on documentID and every
241	// subscription open on it. It is called only after a change-bearing
242	// transaction has committed, so parked readers observe the new rows when they
243	// re-query and pushed frames describe committed changes.
244	func (s *Service) notifyWaiters(documentID string) {
245		s.mu.Lock()
246		set := s.waits[documentID]
247		delete(s.waits, documentID)
248		s.mu.Unlock()
249		for _, ch := range set {
250			close(ch)
251		}
252		s.signalSubscribers(documentID)
253	}

1	// The device pending-change statistics read is the change event service's
2	// read-only answer to "for each of this device's documents, how many online
3	// changes it originated are still outstanding and where does the online log
4	// end": one row per document that currently carries an online change the
5	// device originated, each carrying the document id, the count of online rows
6	// it originated and the largest cursor among them. Like every other read it
7	// sees only the online change log — the retained summaries in
8	// change_identities exist for idempotency alone and never participate in
9	// reads — so a document whose changes were all compacted away, or that was
10	// deleted outright, no longer appears. The read allocates no cursor and
11	// notifies no waiter or subscriber.
12	
13	package events
14	
15	import (
16		"github.com/alicegogogogogo/local-first-sync-service/internal/store"
17	)
18	
19	// PendingChangeStat is one document's pending-change statistics: the document
20	// id, the number of online changes that device originated in it (Count, never
21	// zero for a row that appears) and the largest cursor among those online
22	// changes (MaxCursor).
23	type PendingChangeStat struct {
24		DocumentID string
25		Count      int64
26		MaxCursor  int64
27	}
28	
29	// ListDevicePendingChanges returns one stat per document that currently
30	// carries an online change originated by deviceID — the documents the
31	// device's sessions once wrote changes to and whose change data still exists
32	// — each appearing at most once, sorted lexicographically by document id
33	// ascending and paged by limit/offset as a slice over that fixed order. With
34	// no intervening commit or deletion, successive pages neither repeat nor
35	// skip an id, and an offset past the end yields an empty (non-nil) slice and
36	// no error.
37	//
38	// The count and the maximum cursor count only the device's changes still in
39	// the online log, never the retained summaries compaction leaves behind. An
40	// unregistered device yields store.ErrDeviceNotFound and no statistics. The
41	// read runs in one serialized transaction and writes nothing: a fully
42	// compacted document has no online rows and is absent, exactly as a deleted
43	// document is after its rows were removed.
44	func (s *Service) ListDevicePendingChanges(deviceID string, limit, offset int64) ([]PendingChangeStat, error) {
45		tx, err := s.db.Begin()
46		if err != nil {
47			return nil, err
48		}
49		defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
50	
51		exists, err := store.DeviceExistsTx(tx, deviceID)
52		if err != nil {
53			return nil, err
54		}
55		if !exists {
56			return nil, store.ErrDeviceNotFound
57		}
58	
59		rows, err := tx.Query(
60			`SELECT document_id, COUNT(*), MAX(cursor) FROM changes
61			 WHERE device_id = ?
62			 GROUP BY document_id
63			 ORDER BY document_id ASC
64			 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`,
65			deviceID, limit, offset,
66		)
67		if err != nil {
68			return nil, err
69		}
70		stats := make([]PendingChangeStat, 0)
71		for rows.Next() {
72			var stat PendingChangeStat
73			if err := rows.Scan(&stat.DocumentID, &stat.Count, &stat.MaxCursor); err != nil {
74				_ = rows.Close()
75				return nil, err
76			}
77			stats = append(stats, stat)
78		}
79		if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
80			_ = rows.Close()
81			return nil, err
82		}
83		_ = rows.Close()
84	
85		return stats, tx.Commit()
86	}

1	package events
2	
3	import (
4		"database/sql"
5		"encoding/json"
6		"errors"
7	)
8	
9	// Lookup statuses reported per queried id.
10	const (
11		// LookupFound names an id whose change is still in the online log.
12		LookupFound = "found"
13		// LookupMissing names an id the document has never held a row or a
14		// retained summary for.
15		LookupMissing = "missing"
16		// LookupCompacted names an id whose online row was trimmed by
17		// compaction; only its retained summary survives.
18		LookupCompacted = "compacted"
19	)
20	
21	// ChangeLookup is the answer for one id of a GetChangesByIDs batch, in the
22	// batch's request order. Status is LookupFound, LookupMissing or
23	// LookupCompacted.
24	//
25	// A found answer carries the online row's originating device, the payload
26	// exactly as it was stored at commit time and the cursor it was first
27	// assigned. A compacted answer carries only that first cursor from the
28	// retained summary — DeviceID and Payload are left empty and never restored.
29	// A missing answer carries nothing but the id and its status.
30	type ChangeLookup struct {
31		ID       string
32		Status   string
33		DeviceID string
34		Payload  json.RawMessage
35		Cursor   int64
36	}
37	
38	// GetChangesByIDs answers a read-only batch lookup of change ids for
39	// documentID in exactly the order given. The gate (registration then
40	// permission) is taken first inside one serialized transaction — an
41	// unregistered device yields store.ErrDeviceNotFound and a revoked device
42	// store.ErrPermissionDenied, before any change content is observed. Then each
43	// id is answered independently:
44	//
45	//   - an id with an online row is LookupFound with its device, verbatim
46	//     stored payload and first cursor;
47	//   - an id whose row compaction trimmed is LookupCompacted, reporting only
48	//     the first cursor held in its retained summary — no payload is restored
49	//     and the summary takes no part in any read other than this verdict;
50	//   - any other id (one the document has never known, an unknown document
51	//     included) is LookupMissing.
52	//
53	// Ids may repeat positionally in the answer only when the caller supplied
54	// them repeatedly; the HTTP layer rejects in-batch duplicates before this
55	// runs. The read starts a transaction but writes nothing, allocates no
56	// cursor, creates no change and notifies no waiter or subscriber, so it
57	// cannot move a cursor or wake a parked poll. The verdicts derive solely from
58	// durable rows and are therefore byte-stable across a process restart.
59	func (s *Service) GetChangesByIDs(documentID, deviceID string, ids []string) ([]ChangeLookup, error) {
60		tx, err := s.db.Begin()
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, err
63		}
64		defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback() }()
65	
66		// Gate first, exactly as the gated reads do: the device row and the
67		// permission row are read before any change id is observed, so a rejected
68		// query cannot reveal content.
69		if err := gateTx(s, tx, documentID, deviceID); err != nil {
70			return nil, err
71		}
72	
73		out := make([]ChangeLookup, len(ids))
74		for i, id := range ids {
75			out[i] = ChangeLookup{ID: id, Status: LookupMissing}
76	
77			var device string
78			var payload []byte
79			var cursor int64
80			err := tx.QueryRow(
81				`SELECT device_id, payload, cursor FROM changes
82				 WHERE document_id = ? AND id = ?`,
83				documentID, id,
84			).Scan(&device, &payload, &cursor)
85			switch {
86			case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
87				// No online row: a compaction-trimmed id keeps a retained summary
88				// that still records its first cursor. Anything else never existed.
89				var trimmedCursor int64
90				err := tx.QueryRow(
91					`SELECT cursor FROM change_identities
92					 WHERE document_id = ? AND id = ?`,
93					documentID, id,
94				).Scan(&trimmedCursor)
95				switch {
96				case errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows):
97					// Stays LookupMissing with a zero value.
98				case err != nil:
99					return nil, err
100				default:
101					out[i] = ChangeLookup{
102						ID:     id,
103						Status: LookupCompacted,
104						Cursor: trimmedCursor,
105					}
106				}
107			case err != nil:
108				return nil, err
109			default:
110				out[i] = ChangeLookup{
111					ID:       id,
112					Status:   LookupFound,
113					DeviceID: device,
114					Payload:  json.RawMessage(payload),
115					Cursor:   cursor,
116				}
117			}
118		}
119	
120		if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
121			return nil, err
122		}
123		return out, nil
124	}

1	// Package events is the change event service: the durable per-document change
2	// log together with everything written on top of it.
3	//
4	// Within a document every change has a client-supplied id. New ids receive a
5	// monotonically increasing cursor; re-posting an existing id is idempotent
6	// only when the deviceId and decoded JSON payload match, otherwise it is a
7	// conflict. Valid batches commit atomically in one serialized transaction, so
8	// cursors never repeat and no record is partially written, even under
9	// concurrent writers. Ordinary posts, offline replays, merges and snapshot
10	// restores all allocate from the same per-document contiguous cursor space.
11	//
12	// A document may also carry snapshots: caller-supplied JSON states pinned to
13	// existing change cursors. Snapshots are write-once per cursor — a matching
14	// re-post is idempotent, a differing one a conflict — and live apart from the
15	// change log. A restore appends an ordinary change whose payload is a
16	// snapshot's state, recording its provenance so a repeated restore after a
17	// restart keeps the same idempotency/conflict decisions.
18	//
19	// Reads page by cursor in ascending order. The session view and the document
20	// view are the same read; the HTTP layer adds the session/permission checks.
21	// Long polling and push subscriptions are in-memory observers of commits:
22	// they register before the confirming read, hold no durable state, and are
23	// woken only after a change-bearing transaction has committed.
24	//
25	// The service owns only its own tables. The registration and permission
26	// layers are reached through its Gate interface, so a replay or merge never
27	// reaches into another service's storage.
28	package events
29	
30	import (
31		"encoding/json"
32		"errors"
33		"fmt"
34	)
35	
36	// ErrStoreClosing reports that the service is shutting down and parked long
37	// polls have been woken so they can return without writing anything. The
38	// caller maps it to 503.
39	var ErrStoreClosing = errors.New("store is closing")
40	
41	// Change is one element of an inbound batch or one row of a listing.
42	type Change struct {
43		ID       string          // client-supplied change id, unique per document
44		DeviceID string          // originating device
45		Payload  json.RawMessage // decoded JSON value, stored verbatim
46	}
47	
48	// Result reports the outcome for one element of an accepted batch.
49	type Result struct {
50		ID      string `json:"id"`
51		Created bool   `json:"created"`
52		Cursor  int64  `json:"cursor"`
53	}
54	
55	// ListedChange is one row in a ListChanges response.
56	type ListedChange struct {
57		ID       string          `json:"id"`
58		DeviceID string          `json:"deviceId"`
59		Payload  json.RawMessage `json:"payload"`
60		Cursor   int64           `json:"cursor"`
61	}
62	
63	// MergeResult reports the outcome of an accepted MergeChange. Outcome is one
64	// of "idempotent", "applied" or "merged".
65	type MergeResult struct {
66		ID      string  `json:"id"`
67		Outcome string  `json:"outcome"`
68		Cursor  int64   `json:"cursor"`
69		Result  *Result `json:"result,omitempty"`
70	}
71	
72	// ErrConflict reports that a batch references an existing change id with a
73	// different deviceId or payload. The whole batch is rejected.
74	type ErrConflict struct {
75		ID string
76	}
77	
78	func (e *ErrConflict) Error() string {
79		return fmt.Sprintf("conflicting change %q for document", e.ID)

15	// handleListCRDTOps is the document-level read-only browse entry over a
16	// document's online CRDT operation collection:
17	//
18	//	GET /v1/documents/{documentID}/crdt/list?deviceId=D&limit=N&offset=M
19	//
20	// It is GET with no request body and the calling device is declared by the
21	// deviceId query parameter, the same declaration the other read-only entries
22	// use. limit (1..1000, default 100) and offset (non-negative, default 0) page
23	// the online operations in their stable (ascending operation-id) order; an
24	// illegal value is a 400 JSON error checked before any other verdict. The
25	// page then runs the fixed verdict order — device existence (an unregistered
26	// or unnamed device is a 404), document permission (a revoked device is a
27	// 403) and CRDT state existence (a document with no committed operation is
28	// the same 404 the state read gives); a 404 or 403 exposes no CRDT content.
29	//
30	// Success is one compact JSON line ending in a newline with the top-level
31	// keys ops, count, compacted. Each item names its operation id, source
32	// device, document type and the type-specific comparison content exactly as
33	// saved at commit time, with the query hit's field names. Ids compaction
34	// trimmed never enter the page and their content is never restored; compacted
35	// reports their total count. The listing writes nothing, allocates no change
36	// cursor, wakes no long poll and pushes to no subscriber, so a repeat request
37	// or the same request after a restart renders byte-for-byte the same body.
38	func handleListCRDTOps(s *app.App, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
39		documentID := r.PathValue("documentID") // route pattern + guard guarantee non-empty
40	
41		// Pagination shape is settled before any existence verdict, so an illegal
42		// limit/offset against an unregistered device or an unknown document is
43		// still a 400.
44		limit, offset, ok := parseAttachmentListQuery(w, r)
45		if !ok {
46			return
47		}
48	
49		deviceID := r.URL.Query().Get("deviceId")
50		// A missing or empty deviceId is indistinguishable from an unregistered
51		// caller; judging it here keeps the 404 ahead of any CRDT-content
52		// observation, exactly as the document deletion entry does.
53		if deviceID == "" {
54			writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "device not found")
55			return
56		}
57	
58		page, err := s.ListCRDTOps(documentID, deviceID, limit, offset)
59		if err != nil {
60			writeCRDTLookupError(w, err)
61			return
62		}
63		writeCRDTListResponse(w, page)
64	}
65	
66	// handleSessionListCRDTOps is the session view's counterpart to the
67	// document-level read-only CRDT operation listing:
68	//
69	//	GET /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/crdt/list?limit=N&offset=M
70	//
71	// It is GET with no request body. The calling device is the session's owning
72	// device resolved from the path with the same identity rule as the other
73	// session CRDT entries; a deviceId carried by mistake in the query string is
74	// just another unknown query parameter and can never override the session
75	// owner. limit/offset pagination, the stable order, the page body and the
76	// compacted count are byte-for-byte the document-level listing's. Checks run
77	// in the fixed order request shape (400, the pagination verdict first),
78	// session existence (404), document permission (403) and CRDT state
79	// existence (404); a 404 or 403 exposes no CRDT content and the read wakes
80	// nobody.
81	func handleSessionListCRDTOps(s *app.App, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
82		sessionID := r.PathValue("sessionId")   // route pattern + guard guarantee non-empty
83		documentID := r.PathValue("documentId") // route pattern + guard guarantee non-empty
84	
85		// Pagination shape precedes the session existence verdict, so a malformed
86		// listing against an unknown session is still a 400.
87		limit, offset, ok := parseAttachmentListQuery(w, r)
88		if !ok {
89			return
90		}
91	
92		deviceID, err := s.SessionDevice(sessionID)
93		if err != nil {
94			if errors.Is(err, store.ErrSessionNotFound) {
95				writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "session not found")
96				return
97			}
98			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to look up session")
99			return
100		}
101	
102		// The listing is the same gated read the document-level browse uses: the
103		// registration/permission verdict is retaken inside its transaction, so a
104		// session whose device was deregistered between the two lookups answers
105		// 404 and a revoked device answers 403 before any CRDT content is observed.
106		page, err := s.ListCRDTOps(documentID, deviceID, limit, offset)
107		if err != nil {
108			if errors.Is(err, store.ErrDeviceNotFound) {
109				// The session's device was deregistered between the lookup and the
110				// read; its cascade removed the session too, so the identity the
111				// caller used no longer exists.
112				writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "session not found")
113				return
114			}
115			writeCRDTLookupError(w, err)
116			return
117		}
118		writeCRDTListResponse(w, page)
119	}
120	
121	// crdtListResponse fixes the on-the-wire top-level key order to ops, count and
122	// compacted; count is always the page length and therefore equals the array
123	// length. Ops is always a non-nil slice so an exhausted page serializes as []
124	// rather than null.
125	type crdtListResponse struct {
126		Ops       []json.RawMessage `json:"ops"`
127		Count     int               `json:"count"`
128		Compacted int64             `json:"compacted"`
129	}
130	
131	// writeCRDTListResponse renders the page the single way both list surfaces
132	// emit it: compact single-line JSON, top-level keys ops, count, compacted,
133	// one trailing newline.
134	func writeCRDTListResponse(w http.ResponseWriter, page crdt.OpList) {
135		items := make([]json.RawMessage, len(page.Ops))
136		for i, op := range page.Ops {
137			items[i] = marshalCRDTListItem(op)
138		}
139		writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, crdtListResponse{
140			Ops:       items,
141			Count:     len(items),
142			Compacted: page.Compacted,
143		})
144	}
145	
146	// marshalCRDTListItem renders one listed operation with the fixed key order
147	// id, deviceId, type followed by the type-specific comparison content:
148	//
149	//   - counter: {"id","deviceId","type","value"} with the stored contribution;
150	//   - gset: {"id","deviceId","type","elements"} with the stored element set;
151	//   - register: {"id","deviceId","type","version","value"} with the stored
152	//     version and the value verbatim as it was saved;
153	//   - orset: {"id","deviceId","type","action","element"}.
154	//
155	// Every listed item is an online operation, so it carries no status field;
156	// the content field names are the query hit's. The content is embedded as
157	// native JSON rather than an escaped blob, exactly as the lookup renderer
158	// does.
159	func marshalCRDTListItem(l crdt.OpLookup) json.RawMessage {
160		var buf strings.Builder
161		idRaw, _ := json.Marshal(l.ID)
162		deviceRaw, _ := json.Marshal(l.DeviceID)
163		typeRaw, _ := json.Marshal(l.Type)
164		buf.WriteString(`{"id":`)
165		_, _ = buf.Write(idRaw)
166		buf.WriteString(`,"deviceId":`)
167		_, _ = buf.Write(deviceRaw)
168		buf.WriteString(`,"type":`)
169		_, _ = buf.Write(typeRaw)
170	
171		switch l.Type {
172		case crdt.TypeCounter:
173			buf.WriteString(`,"value":`)
174			_, _ = buf.Write(l.Value)
175		case crdt.TypeGSet:
176			buf.WriteString(`,"elements":`)
177			_, _ = buf.Write(l.Elements)
178		case crdt.TypeRegister:
179			buf.WriteString(`,"version":`)
180			buf.WriteString(strconv.FormatInt(l.Version, 10))
181			buf.WriteString(`,"value":`)
182			_, _ = buf.Write(l.Value)
183		case crdt.TypeORSet:
184			actionRaw, _ := json.Marshal(l.Action)
185			elementRaw, _ := json.Marshal(l.Element)
186			buf.WriteString(`,"action":`)
187			_, _ = buf.Write(actionRaw)
188			buf.WriteString(`,"element":`)
189			_, _ = buf.Write(elementRaw)
190		}
191		buf.WriteString("}")
192		return json.RawMessage(buf.String())
193	}

243	### `POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/changes/replay`
244	
245	会话视角的离线操作重放：断线客户端用**已存在的会话身份**把断线期间攒下的批量操作补回文档，入口挂在会话文档变更集合路径下再追加 `replay` 段。与会话批量提交共用同一套身份判定：会话所属设备即为调用设备，不引入新认证；请求里误带的 `deviceId` 等多余字段一律忽略，不会覆盖会话设备。仅接受 `Content-Type: application/json`。请求体只带按原顺序排列的操作数组：

253	}
254	```
255

257	
258	- `operations` 为非空数组，元素含非空字符串 `id` 和任意合法 JSON `payload`（`null` 亦可），按请求顺序逐项提交；`sessionId`、`documentId` 均为非空字符串。

261	- 同一文档已有标识只有**来源设备与解码后的负载都相同**才算幂等（`created=false`，游标为首次值）；负载或来源设备不一致时返回 `409` JSON 错误并报告冲突标识：`{"error": "...", "conflictId": "..."}`，整批保持原状，不留下半批数据。

274	  "baseCursor": 2,
275	  "change": {"id": "change-3", "payload": {"title": "notes"}}
276	}

310	### `POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/changes/query`

316	```

325	```

332	### `POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/restore`
333	
334	会话视角的历史恢复：客户端用**已存在的会话身份**把某个快照的历史状态写回当前文档，入口挂在会话文档资源下再加 `restore` 子段。与会话批量提交共用同一套身份判定：会话所属设备即为调用设备（来源取自会话归属，请求里误带的 `deviceId` 等多余字段一律忽略，不引入新认证）。仅接受 `Content-Type: application/json`。请求体只带变更标识和快照游标：

336	```json

338	```

- 有效批次在序列化事务内原子提交，与文档级提交、重放和合并共享连续的同一份游标空间：未知文档的首次提交照常成功并从游标 1 开始分配，并发写入不会重复分配游标也不丢记录。写入同步落盘，进程重启后幂等与冲突判定、原始负载和游标读取都保持一致。

### `POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/changes/replay`

会话视角的离线操作重放：断线客户端用**已存在的会话身份**把断线期间攒下的批量操作补回文档，入口挂在会话文档变更集合路径下再追加 `replay` 段。与会话批量提交共用同一套身份判定：会话所属设备即为调用设备，不引入新认证；请求里误带的 `deviceId` 等多余字段一律忽略，不会覆盖会话设备。仅接受 `Content-Type: application/json`。请求体只带按原顺序排列的操作数组：

```json
{
  "operations": [
    {"id": "op-1", "payload": {"any": "json"}},
    {"id": "op-2", "payload": [1, true, null]}
  ]
}
```

行为：

- `operations` 为非空数组，元素含非空字符串 `id` 和任意合法 JSON `payload`（`null` 亦可），按请求顺序逐项提交；`sessionId`、`documentId` 均为非空字符串。
- 成功返回 `200`，正文与文档级重放逐字一致：`{"results":[{"id","created","cursor"}, ...]}`，顺序与请求一致，逐项给出标识、是否新建（`created`）和分配到的首次游标。
- 类型头不符、请求体不是合法 JSON 或带尾随内容、`operations` 缺失或为空、元素缺少非空 `id` 或 `payload`、字段类型错误、批内 `id` 重复，均返回 `400` JSON 错误且整批零写入；方法不是 POST、路径标识为空（连续斜杠或以斜杠结尾）、路径段缺失或多余同样返回 `400` JSON 错误，不重定向也不输出 HTML。
- 同一文档已有标识只有**来源设备与解码后的负载都相同**才算幂等（`created=false`，游标为首次值）；负载或来源设备不一致时返回 `409` JSON 错误并报告冲突标识：`{"error": "...", "conflictId": "..."}`，整批保持原状，不留下半批数据。
- 判定顺序固定为请求形状、会话存在性、文档权限，前序失败优先：会话不存在或已删除返回 `404` JSON 错误，会话所属设备对该文档的权限被撤回返回 `403` JSON 错误，两类失败都不返回变更内容且零写入。
- 取名 `replay` 的会话或文档标识按普通标识处理：其既有行为与其他标识完全一致，关键字只在端点段位置才被当作端点词。
- 有效批次在序列化事务内原子提交，与普通提交、文档级重放、合并和恢复共享同一连续游标空间；并发批次不会重复分配游标、不会丢记录，也不会留下半批数据——每个批次要么整体生效要么整体缺席。写入同步落盘，进程重启后幂等与冲突判定、原始负载和游标读取都保持一致；被压缩裁掉的标识仍凭保留摘要回答幂等与冲突。
- 携带新变更的重放事务提交后立即唤醒长轮询并推送给订阅方；幂等重复提交不分配新游标，不唤醒长轮询也不产生任何推送。订阅建立后权限被撤回以 **4403** 结束、终止信号以 **1001** 结束的既有语义不变。
- 本文档级重放、会话分页读取、区间导出、长轮询、会话批量提交与订阅的既有成功失败语义均不变；快照、恢复、合并、CRDT、附件与权限入口不动。

### `POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/changes/merge`

会话视角的单条基准合并：客户端用**已存在的会话身份**提交一条带基准游标的合并请求，入口挂在会话文档变更集合路径下再加 `merge` 子段。与会话批量提交共用同一套身份判定：会话所属设备即为调用设备（来源取自会话归属，请求里误带的 `deviceId` 等多余字段一律忽略，不引入新认证）。仅接受 `Content-Type: application/json`。请求体只带基准游标和单条变更：

```json
{
  "baseCursor": 2,
  "change": {"id": "change-3", "payload": {"title": "notes"}}
}
```

行为沿用文档级合并的三态结果：

- `sessionId`、`documentId` 均为非空字符串；`baseCursor` 为非负整数（不接受小数、布尔、字符串、`null` 或缺失）；`change` 必填，`change.id` 为非空字符串，`change.payload` 必须是 JSON 对象。
- 成功返回 `200`，响应为单个结果：`{"id","outcome","cursor"}`，说明标识、结果类别和分配到的游标；未新建（`idempotent`）时另附原始结果 `result`（`{"id","created":false,"cursor"}`）。
  - `idempotent`：`change.id` 已存在且**来源设备与解码后的负载都一致**时未新建，返回首次游标与 `result`；负载或来源不一致则 `409`。
  - `applied`：新 `id` 且 `baseCursor` 等于当前游标时直接追加，分配下一个游标。
  - `merged`：新 `id` 但 `baseCursor` 落后于当前游标——仅当 baseCursor 之后的每个负载都是对象、且其顶层字段与新负载的顶层字段均不重名时才追加；字段重名或其后存在非对象负载一律 `409` JSON 错误，零写入。
- 上述合并 `409` 正文与文档级合并统一：`{"error": "...", "conflictId": "<引发冲突的变更 id>"}`。
- 类型头不符、请求体不是合法 JSON、带尾随内容、`baseCursor` 非法（小数、布尔、负数、字符串、`null` 或缺失）、未知文档使用非零 `baseCursor`、或 `baseCursor` 大于当前游标，均返回 `400` JSON 错误且整批零写入；`baseCursor` 低于压缩边界时同样 `400`（冲突检查无法完成）。
- 判定顺序固定为请求形状、会话存在性、文档权限，前序失败优先：会话不存在或已删除返回 `404` JSON 错误，会话所属设备对该文档的权限被撤回返回 `403` JSON 错误，两类失败都不暴露变更内容且零写入。
- 段缺失、空标识、路径段多余（尾斜杠、额外段）或方法不匹配（非 POST）一律返回 `400` JSON 错误，不重定向也不输出 HTML；取名 `merge` 的会话或文档标识按普通标识处理，关键字只在端点段位置才被当作端点词。
- 合并在序列化事务内原子提交，与普通提交、会话批量提交、文档级合并、离线重放和恢复共享同一连续游标空间；并发请求不会重复分配游标也不丢记录，更不会留下半批数据，进程重启后判定与结果一致。
- 携带新变更的合并事务提交后立即唤醒长轮询并推送给订阅方；幂等重复提交不分配新游标，不唤醒长轮询也不产生任何推送。订阅建立后权限被撤回以 **4403** 结束、终止信号以 **1001** 结束的既有语义不变。
- 文档级合并、会话分页读取、区间导出、长轮询、订阅与离线重放的既有成功失败语义均不变；快照、恢复、CRDT、附件与权限入口不动。

### `POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/changes/compact`

会话视角的变更日志压缩：客户端用**已存在的会话身份**把游标不超压缩边界的旧变更移出在线日志，让长期运行的文档不再无限累积，入口挂在会话文档变更集合路径下再加 `compact` 子段。与会话批量提交共用同一套身份判定：会话所属设备即为调用设备（来源取自会话归属），不引入新认证；请求里误带的 `deviceId` 等多余字段一律忽略，不会覆盖会话设备。仅接受 `Content-Type: application/json`。请求体只要是**一个合法 JSON 值**即可（对象、数组、标量、`null` 都行），其内容不参与任何判定：

```json
{}
```

- 压缩边界取该文档已保存快照里的最大游标；没有快照（含未知文档）时边界为 `0` 且照常成功，不移出任何记录。
- 成功返回 `200`，正文为一行紧凑 JSON、末尾一个换行，键按 `boundary`、`removed` 顺序，分别给出压缩边界与本次移出的条数，如 `{"boundary":2,"removed":2}`。重复压缩不报错，返回同一边界与零移出条数；游标空间不重置，新变更照旧从当前最大游标之后继续分配。
- 判定顺序固定为请求形状、会话存在性、文档权限，前序失败优先：类型头不符、请求体不是合法 JSON、带尾随内容均返回 `400` JSON 错误且零写入；会话不存在或已删除返回 `404` JSON 错误，会话所属设备对该文档的权限被撤回返回 `403` JSON 错误（权限判定在压缩事务内取得，故被撤回时不裁掉任何记录，失败请求也观察不到变更内容）。路径标识为空（连续斜杠或以斜杠结尾）、路径段缺失或多余、方法不匹配（非 POST）同样返回 `400` JSON 错误，不重定向也不输出 HTML。取名 `compact` 的会话或文档标识按普通标识处理，关键字只在端点段位置才被当作端点词。
- 被裁标识只保留来源设备、负载与恢复来源的规范摘要及首次游标：摘要只服务幂等与冲突判定，不参与读取，也不让存储涨回压缩前规模。普通提交、离线重放或合并再次提交被裁标识时只比较来源设备与负载，相同仍算未新建（`created=false`，游标为首次值）；内容或来源不一致返回 `409` 且零写入。恢复入口另比恢复来源，判定口径与文档级恢复一致。
- 合并请求的 `baseCursor` 低于压缩边界时无法完成冲突检查，返回 `400` JSON 且零写入。
- 分页与长轮询只返回仍在线的记录，结果按游标递增；结果为空时 `nextCursor` 取起点与压缩边界的较大者，未知文档照旧返回空列表与零游标。订阅起始游标落进被裁区间时，从边界后的首条在线变更补齐，再无缝接实时推送。
- 压缩只影响存储规模：不占用游标、不产生变更，也不唤醒长轮询或推送订阅。压缩在序列化事务内完成并同步落盘，重启后边界、摘要判定与读取结果一致。文档级压缩、变更提交、快照、恢复、合并、CRDT、附件与权限入口的既有行为一律不变。

### `POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/changes/query`

会话视角的按标识批量查询：客户端用**已存在的会话身份**用一次请求取回多个指定变更，入口挂在会话文档的变更集合路径下再加 `query` 子段。会话所属设备即为调用设备，与会话分页读取、区间导出、批量提交、重放、合并、压缩、长轮询和订阅共用同一套身份判定，不引入新认证。仅接受 `POST` 与 `Content-Type: application/json`；请求体只带标识数组，不回传设备（误带的 `deviceId` 等多余字段一律忽略，不会覆盖会话设备）：

```json
{"ids": ["change-2", "change-1"]}
```

- `ids` 为一组非空变更标识，批内不得重复；结果严格按给出的顺序逐项作答，`sessionId`、`documentId` 均为非空字符串。
- 命中在线记录（`"status":"found"`）时返回来源设备 `deviceId`、原始负载 `payload` 与首次游标 `cursor`；`payload` 原样呈现提交时保存的 JSON 内容（可以是 `null`、数字、字符串、数组或对象）。
- 标识从未出现（含整个文档未知）时标记为 `"status":"missing"`，已被压缩裁掉时标记为 `"status":"compacted"`，两者都不返回任何负载内容；被裁标识只凭保留摘要报告首次游标与裁剪状态，不恢复内容也不参与其他读取。
- 查不到的标识照常出现在结果数组里并带缺失标记，这不是错误；正文是一行紧凑 JSON、末尾一个换行，顶层键按 `results`、`count` 的顺序固定，`count` 与数组长度（即请求标识个数）一致。命中项的键按 `id`、`status`、`deviceId`、`payload`、`cursor` 顺序固定；`missing` 项只有 `id`、`status`，`compacted` 项为 `id`、`status`、`cursor`，与文档级按标识查询逐字一致。例如：

```
{"results":[{"id":"change-2","status":"found","deviceId":"device-1","payload":{"any":"json"},"cursor":2},{"id":"change-1","status":"missing"}],"count":2}
```

- 查询是只读动作：不创建变更、不占用游标，也不唤醒长轮询或推送订阅方。
- 判定顺序固定为请求形状、会话存在性、文档权限，前序失败优先：内容类型不符、JSON 非法、带尾随内容、`ids` 组缺失或为空、元素缺标识或类型错误、批内重复，一律 `400` 且零写入；会话不存在或已删除返回 `404` JSON 错误，会话所属设备对该文档的权限被撤回返回 `403` JSON 错误，两类失败都不返回任何变更内容。
- 路径标识为空（连续斜杠或以斜杠结尾）、路径段缺失或多余（如尾斜杠、`changes/query/extra`）、方法不匹配（非 POST）同样返回 `400` JSON 错误，不重定向、不输出 HTML。取名 `query` 的会话或文档标识按普通标识处理，关键字只在端点段位置才被当作端点词。
- 查询结果随落盘数据保持稳定：进程重启后同一请求的正文与判定逐字不变。文档级按标识查询、变更提交、分页读取、区间导出与长轮询的既有语义不变。

### `POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/restore`

会话视角的历史恢复：客户端用**已存在的会话身份**把某个快照的历史状态写回当前文档，入口挂在会话文档资源下再加 `restore` 子段。与会话批量提交共用同一套身份判定：会话所属设备即为调用设备（来源取自会话归属，请求里误带的 `deviceId` 等多余字段一律忽略，不引入新认证）。仅接受 `Content-Type: application/json`。请求体只带变更标识和快照游标：

```json
{"changeId": "change-9", "snapshotCursor": 2}
```

行为与字段口径沿用文档级恢复：

126	### `GET /v1/devices/{deviceId}/documents/pending`
127	
128	设备的文档待续传统计只读入口：让客户端一次看清每个文档还剩多少在线变更。挂在设备资源的文档集合路径下再加 `pending` 子段，用 `GET` 读取且不带请求体；路径上的设备标识就是调用者身份，不新增任何认证机制。
129	
130	- 返回 `200`，正文是一行紧凑 JSON 加末尾换行，顶层键按文档数组与条数的顺序固定出现：
131	
132	  ```
133	  {"documents":[{"documentId":"document-1","changeCount":3,"maxCursor":5},{"documentId":"document-2","changeCount":1,"maxCursor":2}],"count":2}
134	  ```
135	
136	- 统计范围沿用文档清单的取数口径：只统计该设备名下会话曾经写入过变更、且变更仍留在在线日志里的文档。每条固定给出三个字段且键序固定：`documentId`（文档标识）、`changeCount`（仍在线的变更条数）、`maxCursor`（这些在线变更中的最大游标）；条数与最大游标只统计仍留在在线日志里的变更，压缩留下的去重摘要不参与统计。同一文档在一次结果里最多出现一次，全部条目按文档标识的字典序升序排列（与写入先后无关）。`count` 给出本页条数，始终与数组长度一致。
137	- 分页在这一固定顺序上切片，参数口径与文档清单一致：`limit` 只接受 `1..1000` 的整数，缺省 `100`；`offset` 只接受非负整数，缺省 `0`，表示先跳过前面若干条。两次读取之间没有新增或删除时，翻页得到的条目不重不漏；越过末尾时返回空数组与零计数（`{"documents":[],"count":0}` 加换行），空统计照样返回 `200`，不是错误。
138	- 任一非法分页取值先于其他判定返回 `400` JSON 错误；设备未注册或已注销返回 `404` JSON 错误，且不返回任何统计内容。判定顺序固定为请求形状再到设备存在性，前序失败优先返回，失败一律零写入。
139	- 标识为空（连续斜杠或尾随斜杠）、段缺失或多余、方法不匹配一律返回 `400` JSON 错误，不重定向也不输出 HTML。取名 `pending` 的设备标识按普通标识处理，`pending` 这个词只在端点段位置才被识别为关键字。
140	- 统计是只读动作：不创建或删除文档与变更，也不占用变更游标或推送订阅。文档被整体删除、或其在线变更被清空（全部压缩出在线日志）后不再出现，条目与数字随落盘数据保持稳定；设备注销期间其统计按未注册设备返回 `404`。
141	- 重复请求与进程重启后，同一请求的正文逐字不变，读取不改动任何状态。本入口不改变变更提交、读取、压缩、合并、快照、恢复与 CRDT 入口的既有语义。
142	
143	### `GET /v1/devices/{deviceId}/subscriptions`
144	
145	设备的订阅管理只读入口：列出该设备当前**活着**的全部推送订阅连接。路径上的 `deviceId` 就是调用者唯一身份，不新增任何认证机制；无请求体。
146	
147	- 该设备经文档级订阅声明（查询参数 `deviceId`）建立的连接，以及经它名下会话建立的连接，都出现在列表里；增量变更订阅与 CRDT 状态订阅两种通道一并列出。
148	- 正文是一行紧凑 JSON 加末尾换行，顶层键按 `subscriptions`、`count` 的顺序固定出现：
149	
150	  ```json
151	  {"subscriptions":[{"subscriptionId":"sub-1","documentId":"doc-a","kind":"changes","cursor":5,"establishedAt":1727000000000}],"count":1}
152	  ```
153	
154	- 每条订阅固定给出五个字段且键序固定：`subscriptionId`（订阅标识，连接建立时由服务端分配，本进程内不重复，断开后不再出现于任何列表）、`documentId`（文档标识）、`kind`（通道种类：变更订阅为 `"changes"`，状态订阅为 `"state"`）、`cursor`（握手时请求的起始游标；状态订阅没有游标，这一项记 `0`）、`establishedAt`（连接建立时间，Unix 毫秒整数）。
155	- 全部条目按连接建立的先后升序排列，`count` 与数组长度始终一致。
156	- 列表是纯内存视图：客户端断开或进程重启后条目立即消失，不落盘、不写入任何记录，也不占用变更游标。没有任何存活订阅时照样返回 `200`，正文为 `{"subscriptions":[],"count":0}` 加换行——空列表不是错误。
157	- 调用设备未注册返回 `404` JSON 错误；路径标识为空（连续斜杠或尾随斜杠）、段缺失或多余、方法不匹配一律返回 `400` JSON 错误，不重定向也不输出 HTML。
158	
159	### `DELETE /v1/devices/{deviceId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}`
160	
161	设备的订阅主动回收入口：按订阅标识结束该设备名下指定的那一条存活连接。路径上的 `deviceId` 是唯一身份，无请求体。
162	
163	- 成功返回一行 JSON：`200` `{"subscriptionId":"sub-1","deleted":true}` 加换行，不新增其他字段。
164	- 目标连接随即以关闭码 **4410** 结束并停止推送；同一文档的其他订阅方完全不受影响，后续提交照常推达。主动取消只结束目标连接：权限撤回仍以 `4403` 结束，终止信号仍以 `1001` 结束并零状态退出。
165	- 判定顺序固定为请求形状（`400`）→ 设备存在性（`404`）→ 订阅归属（`404`），前序失败优先返回；任何失败都不写入、不关闭其他连接。
166	- 订阅标识不存在、订阅已经断开、或属于其他设备，一律返回同一个 `404` JSON 错误，不泄露任何订阅内容；调用设备未注册同样返回 `404`。
167	- 路径标识为空（连续斜杠或尾随斜杠）、段缺失（如 `DELETE /v1/devices/{deviceId}/subscriptions`）或多余、方法不匹配一律返回 `400` JSON 错误，不重定向也不输出 HTML。
168	- 重复取消同一订阅同样返回 `404` 且不改变任何状态；失败响应不重定向也不输出 HTML。
169	
170	### `GET /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/documents/{documentId}/changes`
171	
172	会话视角的增量读取，查询参数与响应结构与 `GET /v1/documents/{documentID}/changes` 完全一致（`after`、`limit` 语义、`changes`/`nextCursor` 形状、未知文档返回空列表且 `nextCursor` 为 `0`）。
173	
174	- `sessionId`、`documentId` 均为非空字符串；空段返回 `400` JSON 错误而非重定向。
175	- `after`、`limit` 非法返回 `400` JSON 错误（参数校验先于会话存在性检查）。

### `GET /v1/devices/{deviceId}/documents/pending`

设备的文档待续传统计只读入口：让客户端一次看清每个文档还剩多少在线变更。挂在设备资源的文档集合路径下再加 `pending` 子段，用 `GET` 读取且不带请求体；路径上的设备标识就是调用者身份，不新增任何认证机制。

- 返回 `200`，正文是一行紧凑 JSON 加末尾换行，顶层键按文档数组与条数的顺序固定出现：

  ```
  {"documents":[{"documentId":"document-1","changeCount":3,"maxCursor":5},{"documentId":"document-2","changeCount":1,"maxCursor":2}],"count":2}
  ```

- 统计范围沿用文档清单的取数口径：只统计该设备名下会话曾经写入过变更、且变更仍留在在线日志里的文档。每条固定给出三个字段且键序固定：`documentId`（文档标识）、`changeCount`（仍在线的变更条数）、`maxCursor`（这些在线变更中的最大游标）；条数与最大游标只统计仍留在在线日志里的变更，压缩留下的去重摘要不参与统计。同一文档在一次结果里最多出现一次，全部条目按文档标识的字典序升序排列（与写入先后无关）。`count` 给出本页条数，始终与数组长度一致。
- 分页在这一固定顺序上切片，参数口径与文档清单一致：`limit` 只接受 `1..1000` 的整数，缺省 `100`；`offset` 只接受非负整数，缺省 `0`，表示先跳过前面若干条。两次读取之间没有新增或删除时，翻页得到的条目不重不漏；越过末尾时返回空数组与零计数（`{"documents":[],"count":0}` 加换行），空统计照样返回 `200`，不是错误。
- 任一非法分页取值先于其他判定返回 `400` JSON 错误；设备未注册或已注销返回 `404` JSON 错误，且不返回任何统计内容。判定顺序固定为请求形状再到设备存在性，前序失败优先返回，失败一律零写入。
- 标识为空（连续斜杠或尾随斜杠）、段缺失或多余、方法不匹配一律返回 `400` JSON 错误，不重定向也不输出 HTML。取名 `pending` 的设备标识按普通标识处理，`pending` 这个词只在端点段位置才被识别为关键字。
- 统计是只读动作：不创建或删除文档与变更，也不占用变更游标或推送订阅。文档被整体删除、或其在线变更被清空（全部压缩出在线日志）后不再出现，条目与数字随落盘数据保持稳定；设备注销期间其统计按未注册设备返回 `404`。

### `GET /v1/documents/{documentID}/changes`

分页游标读取：

- `after`：非负整数，默认 `0`，只返回 cursor 严格大于它的变更。
- `limit`：`1..1000` 的整数，默认 `100`。
- 参数非法返回 `400` JSON 错误。
- 响应：`{"changes":[{"id","deviceId","payload","cursor"}, ...], "nextCursor": N}`，`changes` 按 cursor 递增。
- 已知文档但 `after` 之后无数据时 `nextCursor` 等于 `after`；未知文档返回空列表且 `nextCursor` 为 `0`。

游标在每个文档内独立、从 1 开始、连续不重复，可作为断点续传位置持久保存。

### `GET /v1/documents/{documentID}/changes`（区间批量导出）

同一个变更集合路径在携带 `from`/`to` 查询参数时即成为批量导出入口，让客户端按游标闭区间一次性取走历史变更。仍为 `GET`、无请求体；与分页读取互斥——带 `from` 或 `to` 走导出，两者都不带时走上面的 `after`/`limit` 分页读取。查询参数：

- `from`：闭区间起点，十进制非负整数，缺省为 `0`。
- `to`：闭区间终点，十进制非负整数；缺省时不设上界。终点小于起点返回 `400` JSON 错误。

行为：

- 只导出 cursor 落在闭区间 `[from, to]` 内**且仍在在线日志里**的变更，按游标升序排列，同一游标最多出现一次；每条记录与分页读取同游标上的记录逐字一致。
- 未知文档或区间内没有变更时照样成功：返回 `200`，正文为空数组与零计数，而不是错误。
- 已被压缩移出在线日志的变更不在导出结果里；区间整体落进被裁区间时按空结果返回，跨越边界的区间只返回边界之后的在线记录。
- 正文是一行紧凑 JSON、末尾一个换行，顶层键按 `changes`、`count` 的顺序固定；每条记录只有 `id`、`deviceId`、`payload`、`cursor` 四个键且键序固定，`payload` 原样呈现提交时保存的 JSON 内容（可以是 `null`、数字、字符串、数组或对象）。`count` 为本次导出的条数，与数组长度一致。例如：

```
{"changes":[{"id":"change-1","deviceId":"device-1","payload":{"any":"json"},"cursor":1}],"count":1}
```

- 导出是只读动作：不创建变更、不占用游标，也不产生变更记录或推送通知（不唤醒长轮询、不推送订阅）。
- 导出期间并发提交的变更要么整体出现在结果里，要么整体缺席，不会读到半个批次（单条 SELECT 观察序列化连接上的已提交事务）。
- `from`/`to` 不是十进制非负整数、终点小于起点、`documentID` 为空，均返回 `400` JSON 错误且零写入。
- 路径段缺失或多余（如 `/v1/documents/{id}/changes/`、`/v1/documents/{id}/changes/extra`）、方法不是 `GET`（集合路径上的 `POST` 仍是上面的提交入口，其余方法一律 `400`）同样返回 `400` JSON 错误，不重定向也不输出 HTML；这些失败一律零写入。
- 变更同步落盘，进程重启后同一区间导出的正文逐字不变。

### `GET /v1/documents/{documentID}/changes/poll`

断线客户端的长轮询续传入口，在 `GET .../changes` 的分页语义上增加一个等待期限。查询参数：

- `after`：非负整数，默认 `0`，只返回 cursor 严格大于它的变更（沿用既有变更读取约束）。

- `waitMs`：`0..30000` 的整数，默认 `0`，即愿意为后续变更等待的毫秒数。

- `after` 之后已有变更时立即返回，不进入等待；响应结果继续按 cursor 递增。

1	// Package authz is the permission service: the durable, per-document and
2	// per-device authorization ledger together with the system's single revoke
3	// verdict.
4	//
5	// Every (document, device) pair starts authorized; a grant or revoke is
6	// recorded per pair. The lookup and the write run in one serialized
7	// transaction on the shared connection and commit to disk, so concurrent
8	// grant/revoke calls each land as a complete state and survive a restart.
9	//
10	// The other services do not read the permission table. They take their
11	// registration-and-authorization verdict through AuthorizedTx, evaluated
12	// inside their own write transaction, so a rejected request is judged before
13	// any document content is observed and the gate and the gated work commit as
14	// one judgment. Revoking never deletes changes, snapshots, sessions or CRDT
15	// state; it only produces the denial and, after the revoke commits, notifies
16	// the registered revoke sinks (the live subscription registries) so they can
17	// end the affected connections with the one-time, sticky 4403 close.
18	package authz
19	
20	import (
21		"database/sql"
22		"errors"
23		"sync"
24	
25		"github.com/alicegogogogogo/local-first-sync-service/internal/store"
26	)
27	
28	// schema is created when the service is constructed; its shape is unchanged
29	// from the pre-refactor layout, so authorization rows already on disk stay
30	// readable.
31	const schema = `
32	CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS document_permissions (
33		document_id TEXT NOT NULL,
34		device_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
35		authorized  INTEGER NOT NULL,
36		PRIMARY KEY (document_id, device_id)
37	);
38	`
39	
40	// RevokeSink observes a committed revoke. The change event service and the
41	// CRDT service register themselves to end the affected live subscriptions; a
42	// sink must not block and must be safe to call after the revoke transaction
43	// has committed. The permission service depends on this interface alone, so
44	// the dependency points from the observers toward the verdict and never back.
45	type RevokeSink interface {
46		PermissionRevoked(documentID, deviceID string)
47	}
48	
49	// Service is the permission service.
50	type Service struct {
51		db *sql.DB
52	
53		mu    sync.Mutex
54		sinks []RevokeSink
55	}
56	
57	// New constructs the permission service over the shared kernel handle and
58	// creates its table.
59	func New(kernel *store.Store) (*Service, error) {
60		db := kernel.DB()
61		if _, err := db.Exec(schema); err != nil {
62			return nil, err
63		}
64		return &Service{db: db}, nil
65	}
66	
67	// AddRevokeSink registers an observer notified after every committed revoke.
68	// It is called by the composition root while wiring the services, before the
69	// surface serves requests.
70	func (s *Service) AddRevokeSink(sink RevokeSink) {
